values.note: Belvidere Township: campsite with camper or trailer $35 a night, tent $25; monthly camper/trailer rate $750. No resident/non-resident difference is published.

fees.source: https://belvideretownshipmi.gov/parks/ ('Campsite Nightly Rental with Camper: $35/night', 'Campsite Nightly Rental with Tent: $25/night', 'Campsite Monthly Rental: $750/month') + Belvidere-Twp-ParkCampground.pdf (uploaded 2026-08: 'Nightly/Daily Rates: Camper/Trailer $35.00; Tent $25.00', 'Monthly Camper/Trailer Rate: $750.00'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Camping from the first Friday in May through September 30.

season.source: Belvidere-Twp-ParkCampground.pdf ('Camping is available from the first Friday in May through September 30 of each year') + https://belvideretownshipmi.gov/parks/ ('The campground will be closed for the season on September 30th, 2026'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: Belvidere-Twp-ParkCampground.pdf (page 3, 'First Lake Campground/Park' map: Lots 1-30), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: Belvidere-Twp-ParkCampground.pdf (rules: 'Children must be accompanied by a responsible adult when swimming or showering', 'shower/bathroom area'; map shows a Bathhouse), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reservations in person or by phone: January 1 - April 15 through the township office (989-365-3783, Mon-Wed 9 am - 1 pm), after April 15 with the park manager (989-365-3555, 9 am - 5 pm). Check-in 1-5 pm Mon-Thu, 1-7 pm Fri-Sun; check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://belvideretownshipmi.gov/parks/ ('Reservations can be made January 1st to April 15th by calling the office ... (989) 365-3783 ... After April 15th, Park Manager ... at (989) 365-3555', check-in/out hours) + Belvidere-Twp-ParkCampground.pdf ('Reservations may be made in person or by phone', 'Maximum stay is 30 consecutive days'), read 2026-10-22

note: Municipal campground operated by Belvidere Township at 9888 Park Rd, Six Lakes = LOCAL ownership (candidate was tagged private); offers town lake access on First Lake, with a swimming beach, playground, pavilion and fish-cleaning station. --Claude
summary: Township page and its 2026 campground packet confirm $35 camper / $25 tent (monthly $750), phone reservations; added season (first Friday in May - Sept 30), 30 lots, bathhouse showers, 30-night maximum and booking details. Hookups are not stated anywhere (left unknown). No resident/non-resident split. Note: rate and booking text dropped (now in fields).
